event.title: FDA approval of midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD
event.proposition: The FDA approves midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for post-traumatic stress disorder.
event.criterion: TRUE on the date the FDA approval letter or Drugs@FDA entry (or the sponsor's approval announcement) for midomafetamine for PTSD is dated, on any review cycle. A complete response letter, a positive advisory vote or a filing acceptance is not an approval. A label narrower than PTSD (for example a PTSD subgroup) counts if the claim's indication reasonably includes it and the reading is logged at intake.
readings: Approval under any sponsor name (MAPS PBC, Lykos Therapeutics or a successor) counts; the entry is on the asset.

'MDMA-assisted psychotherapy', 'MDMA-assisted therapy', 'MDMA-AT', 'approval for prescription use' and 'prescription access to MDMA' name the same asset and outcome. DEA rescheduling that follows approval is not a separate requirement.
This is eventual approval on any review cycle, distinct from the first-cycle event new:fda-midomafetamine-ptsd-first-cycle-approval.

records.phrase: the possibility of FDA approval for prescription use sometime in 2024
records.stage_note: At the statement date (2023-01-23) the Phase 3 program (two pivotal trials) was complete or completing and the NDA had not been submitted; the forecaster's own timetable places approval in 2024, so submission was still ahead. Class phase3_to_approval_psychiatry (p 0.563, median 36 months). Alternative class btd_to_approval (p 0.72): the FDA granted breakthrough therapy designation to MDMA-assisted psychotherapy for PTSD in August 2017, before every Doblin statement in this packet; this coder keeps the stage-based Phase 3 class for all pre-NDA items. Window 2023-01-23 to 2024-12-31 is 23 months, below the 36-month median, so b is halved.
records.note: FDA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy for prescription use sometime in 2024. 'Sometime in 2024' = 2024-12-31 (year rule, origin anchor). 'Possibility' sets bin C; asserts true. Affiliated: MAPS and MAPS PBC roles.

'Prescription sales of MDMA might cover all of MAPS PBC's expenses' over the next two years: MAPS PBC is a private benefit corporation with no named public series for sales or expenses, so the threshold cannot be resolved. The two-year horizon (2025-01-23) is usable but the event is not. Alternative code CONTROL (own organization's finances) is secondary.

'A world of net-zero trauma by 2070' is a societal outcome, not a regulatory, trial, company, payer or practice-adoption event (finder area 'other'). It is also VAGUE: 'net-zero trauma' has no metric, and 'can lead to' asserts possibility of a mechanism, not an outcome. One code is required; OUT_OF_AREA is the first failed admission test.

records.note: First-cycle approval of the Lykos midomafetamine NDA in August 2024; mapped to the existing proposal new:fda-midomafetamine-ptsd-first-cycle-approval. 'Substantially more than a 50/50 chance' is a qualified number and takes the qualifier's bin, B (lexicon rule); p_stated is null. 'In August' = 2024-08-31 (month rule, origin anchor); the forecaster does not say 'by the PDUFA date', so the published PDUFA date is not used. Asserts true. Affiliated: the Lykos affiliation (founder, former board member) runs to 2024-08-31, after the statement date, and MAPS is the parent. Not KNOWN: no FDA action on the NDA at the statement date.

'I'm quite optimistic' names no event, entity, threshold or date in the forecaster's words; the '12 months' horizon in the context is RFK Jr.'s statement, not Doblin's, and adopting it would be a third-party horizon. The second sentence is a worry about public perception, not a forecast.

'We knew the FDA wasn't saying no, just not yet. We believed the data were valid...' is retrospective: it describes past belief and characterises the 2024 complete response letter. No future state is asserted in the words; the expectation of eventual approval is the finder's inference from 'not yet'. If a coder admitted it, the event would be new:fda-midomafetamine-ptsd-approval, undated, and affiliation would turn on whether MAPS's founding stake in the sponsor counts after the listed Lykos affiliation ended on 2024-08-31.
